In this video we cover:
Amara Raja & Exide Q4 Results: Challenges & Future Strategy
Amara Raja and Exide reported weak Q4 results for FY25—Amara Raja's profit fell 45%, while Exide's rose 18%. Both companies are under pressure due to rising raw material costs, lithium import dependence, loss of telecom clients, and cheap Chinese battery imports.
To tackle this, they’re shifting focus to high-margin lithium-ion battery manufacturing, investing in new facilities, and targeting global markets with advanced NMC battery technology. The EV boom and export opportunities may help them regain momentum.
